subject.title: [Bug]: Tool display missing file path when model uses "file" parameter alias

question: Should Read/Write/Edit display and read-start diagnostics continue recognizing legacy path aliases such as `file`, `filePath`, and `file_path` even though current execution validation requires canonical `path`?
rationale: Current main has a source-repro display and diagnostic gap, but tests also encode canonical `path` as the runtime contract, so automation should not choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve display alias compatibility
options.body: Treat legacy aliases as accepted presentation inputs, refresh the linked PR or a replacement to update the active handler, metadata, and tests, while keeping execution validation policy explicit.

options.title: Standardize on canonical path only
options.body: Document or test that alias-only calls are rejected and remove stale display/diagnostic alias expectations consistently.

recommendation.title: Preserve display alias compatibility
recommendation.body: Treat legacy aliases as accepted presentation inputs, refresh the linked PR or a replacement to update the active handler, metadata, and tests, while keeping execution validation policy explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the current active handler, runtime validation direction, and recent agent-runtime refactor history tied to this path.
